pages.title: Sea Life
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Hybrid Aquatic** adds well over a hundred sea creatures and new ocean biomes.
- **Naturalist** animals that Hybrid Aquatic covers are off; its whale, clam, bass and catfish still spawn.
- **Aquamirae** adds an icy ocean region with its own creatures and bosses.

The pack's ocean is crowded. **Hybrid Aquatic** is the big one: well over a hundred new sea creatures, from clownfish and seahorses to orcas, whale sharks and colossal squid, plus new ocean biomes to hold them.

Biomes include:

- Coral Reef, Deep Coral Reef, Seagrass Bed, Tide Pools
- Red Meadow, Sulfuric Caves
- Warm, Cold, Frozen and Lukewarm Trenches
- a Tropical River biome on land

New coral types and bleached variants come with them.

pages.title: Hunters
pages.text:
Orcas, sharks, squid and the big predatory fish hunt smaller fish and turtles. After a kill a hunter is full for about 45 seconds before it hunts again.\
\
Prey they kill leaves nothing behind, so a pod of orcas won't cover the sea in fish. For fish of your own, catch them with a rod or a fishing net.

pages.title: Crab Eaters
pages.text:
Otters, octopuses, cuttlefish and some fish hunt crabs and shrimp the same way.\
\
Hermit crabs are off every hunter's menu, so otters on a beach won't wipe them out. A fishing net still catches them.

pages.title: Voltaic Sea Grass
pages.text:
Glowing sea grass in cold oceans. Moving through it shocks you for 2 damage a hit, drowned too. Fish and other sea life swim through it unharmed.\
\
Fan bulk freezing turns seagrass into it.

pages.title: Ominous Conch
pages.text: Tied to Hybrid Aquatic's Karkinos crab boss. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for its uses.

pages.title: Magnetic Hook
pages.text: One of several special fishing hooks: Barbed, Glowing, CreeperMagnet, Ominous and Magnetic.

**Naturalist** adds land and sea animals.

- **Off here**, because Hybrid Aquatic covers them: anglerfish, blobfish, giant isopod, great white shark, piranha, jellyfish, starfish, crab and ray. Their buckets and eggs are hidden from JEI.
- **Still spawn**: whale, clam, bass, catfish and the rest.

pages.title: Diving Suit
pages.text: Hybrid Aquatic's underwater armor. See [#](2E5AAC)[Diving Gear](entry://ocean/diving)[#]() for how it compares with other options.

pages.title: Whale
pages.text: Naturalist's whale still spawns here. Clams also drop Clam Meat, used in cooking.

Other sea residents: [#](2E5AAC)[Aquamirae](entry://ocean/aquamirae)[#]() adds an icy ocean region with its own creatures and bosses, and **Critters and Companions** adds koi fish (its otter, Dumbo Octopus and Sea Bunny are off here; Hybrid Aquatic's sea slug gives Sea Bunny Slime and its otters crack clams: see [#](2E5AAC)[Creatures](entry://exploration/creatures)[#]()). [#](2E5AAC)[Structures](entry://ocean/underwater_places)[#]() give them places to live. Fish worth catching: [#](2E5AAC)[Fishing](entry://fishing/overview)[#]().
